title: THE HOUSE STUDY — briefing for the Wednesday 2026-07-22 meeting
author: Research session, 2026-07-19
thesis: Do not pitch "use AI" to the house: the CEO already preaches it. The gap in Reconthe house is a layer that treats the brand's meaning system as something that can be held, examined and simulated — pitch above his stack, never beside it.

key_claims.claim: The group is mid-crisis and the CEO is in pre-results mode.
key_claims.quote: 2025 ended in a net loss after three years of decline, Gucci is still shrinking, and the group has publicly diagnosed its own China problem as "low cultural relevance."

key_claims.claim: The CEO's own words hand the pitch its opening.
key_claims.quote: How can we apply AI to actually help the creative people get better, faster, stronger?

key_claims.claim: Three framings could misfire; all AI must stay backstage.
key_claims.quote: keep all AI strictly backstage (customer-facing AI is reputationally radioactive in fashion right now), and never cite the unverified "Gucci GPT" story.

title: The fourth field — holding a house's meaning as a structure
author: Working paper, July 2026
thesis: A luxury house's coherence across levels — group philosophy, house codes, collection architecture, product, and the discourse around them — can be held as an explicit, versioned structure that every strategic move is read against, before execution and after the world answers.

key_claims.claim: The existing stack follows three fields and none of them is meaning.
key_claims.quote: Follow the client, follow the product, follow the money. These are the three fields of application for AI.

key_claims.claim: Creative succession is the sector's recurring shock and the structure must survive it.
key_claims.quote: four houses changed creative hands in eighteen months — the house's grammar has to be maintained across creative hands, not inside one of them.

key_claims.claim: The instrument reads moves, it does not make them.
key_claims.quote: The read is a reading, not a verdict: it says which level a move reinforces, which it strains, and what the record shows the last time the house did this.
